aggregate_capacity.source: CEA transmission resource adequacy plan / Kerala2040 canonical March-2026 capacity boundary

station_unit_anchor.source: KSEBL station-wise installed generating capacity / Annual Administration Report
station_unit_anchor.role: unit-size/outage stress anchor only; not treated as a current March-2026 complete station register
station_unit_anchor.caveat: Legacy station/unit table predates the March-2026 aggregate boundary; later additions/re-ratings are not reconstructed station-by-station in v1.1.

observed_energy_boundary.source: SLDC FY2024-25 daily balance archive already admitted in v0.2-v0.4
observed_energy_boundary.rule: Conserve each observed/imputed FY2024-25 daily hydro MWh exactly in every v1.1 case.
observed_energy_boundary.interpretation: Daily energy is evidence-backed; intraday allocation remains optimized.
